sources.title: Possible Physical Realizations of the Tolman VII solution
sources.authors: A. M. Raghoonundun and D. W. Hobill
sources.evidence: Exact quadratic density, complete interior metric and pressure, regular-origin mass condition, Israel-Darmois matching to Schwarzschild, causal compactness boundary about 0.27--0.29, and stability criteria.

sources.title: The Tolman VII solution, trapped null orbits and w-modes
sources.authors: N. Neary, M. Ishak and K. Lake
sources.evidence: Independent perturbative mode analysis on the exact Tolman VII geometry and a causal parameter region.

sources.title: General-Relativistic Fluid Spheres
sources.evidence: A regular finite gaseous sphere with pressure and density vanishing together at the boundary and closed-form potentials, matter variables and equation of state.

sources.title: The Stability of an Isentropic Model for a Gaseous Relativistic Star
sources.evidence: Reports the isentropic Buchdahl subclass regular, stable and gravitationally bound for 0 < M/R <= 0.20.

sources.title: ell-Boson stars
sources.evidence: Fully nonlinear static spherical EKG definition, rigorous local origin behavior, asymptotic shooting construction, globally regular numerical profiles and finite ADM mass.

sources.title: Dynamical ell-boson stars: generic stability and evidence for non-spherical solutions
sources.evidence: Independent 3D nonlinear evolutions support a stable spherical branch but also find zero-mode evidence, so robustness is not scored as fully closed.

sources.title: Existence of nonrelativistic ell- and multi-ell-boson stars and their radial stability
sources.authors: E. Chávez Nambo and O. Sarbach
sources.evidence: Variational existence and orbital stability for the nonrelativistic system; useful benchmark, but not a proof of the relativistic EKG member.

sources.title: Quantum fields in boson star spacetime
sources.authors: P. M. Saffin and Q.-X. Xie
sources.evidence: Direct spectral quantum-field and renormalized-stress computation on ordinary ell=0 boson-star backgrounds, with coherent-state fluctuations; explicitly generalizable, but not a same-family ell=1 result.

sources.title: Numerical evolutions of spherical Proca stars
sources.evidence: Everywhere nonsingular spherical Einstein-Proca equilibria and nonlinear evolution confirming the stable/unstable split at maximum ADM mass.

sources.title: Nonrelativistic Proca stars: Spherical stationary and multi-frequency states
sources.evidence: Analytic ground-state conditions plus numerical spherical solutions in the nonrelativistic theory; useful but not a relativistic proof.

sources.title: Numerical simulation of oscillatons: extracting the radiating tail
sources.authors: P. Grandclément, G. Fodor and P. Forgács
sources.evidence: High-precision spectral work finds a nonzero standing-wave tail: exact periodic solutions have infinite mass, while finite-mass oscillatons radiate and are only approximately periodic.

sources.title: Adiabatic Vacua and Hadamard States for Scalar Quantum Fields on Curved Spacetime
sources.evidence: Shows ground and KMS states on suitable static globally hyperbolic spacetimes are Hadamard, providing the state-construction route for static candidates.

sources.title: Hadamard renormalization of the stress-energy tensor for a quantized scalar field in a general spacetime of arbitrary dimension
sources.evidence: General local Hadamard RSET renormalization and ambiguity/counterterm framework.

sources.title: Noise Kernel in Stochastic Gravity and Stress Energy Bi-Tensor of Quantum Fields in Curved Spacetimes
sources.authors: N. G. Phillips and B. L. Hu
sources.evidence: Derives a regularized scalar-field stress-noise kernel for general curved spacetimes.

sources.title: Renormalization of the Quantum Stress Tensor Fluctuations and the Limits of Semiclassical Gravity
sources.evidence: Renormalizes both mean stress and the fluctuation tensor for suitable Hadamard states and supplies a later semiclassicality criterion.
